chunks: From him, from Musa ibn al-Qasim, from Safwan, from Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to apply kohl before sleeping: four times in the right eye and three times in the left.
ai.seo_question: What was the Prophet's practice regarding applying kohl before sleep?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi’s chapter on hygiene, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) via Zurarah specifies the Prophet’s (PBUH) routine of applying kohl with a precise asymmetry of four strokes in the right eye and three in the left, reflecting the Islamic preference for the right side. This practice underscores the integration of physical health and spiritual discipline, where kohl serves not only as a prophylactic against eye ailments but also as a means of attracting barakah through adherence to the Sunnah.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Musa Bin Al Qasim, from Safwan, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> used to apply Kohl before he<sup>saww</sup> slept – four (times) in the right, and three (times) in the left’.
en.sarwar: 12. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Musa ibn al-Qasim from Safwan from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, applied eye powder before going to sleep-four times in the right and three in the left.’”
